name: Jeeter | Apples and Bananas | 2G Liquid Diamond XL All-In-One Vape
description: Apples and Bananas is a balanced hybrid with a flavor that lives up to its name. Expect a sweet and fruity profile filled with sugary banana notes and sour apple tartness, rounded out by a hint of black pepper. The aroma leans spicier, with a sharp punch of savory diesel. Bold, flavorful, and aromatic, Apples and Bananas stands out as a go-to for those who like their strains loud and layered.
